translations.web: They don’t know, neither do they consider: for he has shut their eyes, that they can’t see; and their hearts, that they can’t understand.
translations.bsb: They do not comprehend or discern, for He has shut their eyes so they cannot see and closed their minds so they cannot understand.
translations.kjv: They have not known nor understood: for he hath shut their eyes, that they cannot see; and their hearts, that they cannot understand.
translations.asv: They know not, neither do they consider: for he hath shut their eyes, that they cannot see; and their hearts, that they cannot understand.
